method: Same stage 1, seeded initial state, viewport 1280x800, enemy-first ordinary input policy. Separate live runs, not lockstep input. Sum intervals with no living enemy and incomplete relay. Combat/reinforcements excluded. rAF observations ±1 frame (~16.7ms); 0ms means same observed frame. Different reinforcement counts are disclosed; not an average or Human measure.

before.recording: continuous native capture from initial arena through first choice; no cut, retiming, or generated frames
